name: mapgame-d3-build
description: Builds vendor/d3.min.js with only the d3 modules MapGame uses (see entry.js). Run: npm install && npm run build

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=d3 --banner:js="// MapGame custom d3 build (d3-selection, d3-transition, d3-zoom, d3-geo, d3-scale, d3-axis, d3-shape, d3-array). Rebuild: tools/d3-build/" --outfile=../../vendor/d3.min.js
